name: Relation Set Metrics (PGM)
process:
calculator = get_plugin('MetricsCalculation')
entities = state.get('entities')
expected_raw = calculator.normalize_cid_lines(state.get('ground_truth', []), entities)
predicted_raw = calculator.normalize_cid_lines(state.get('relations', []), entities)
expected = calculator.parse_relation_pairs(expected_raw)
predicted = calculator.parse_relation_pairs(predicted_raw)
__result__ = calculator.calculate(expected, predicted)
description: Evaluates chemical–induced-disease relation sets by normalizing and comparing predicted relations to ground truth.
